recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any further precision about display-language fallback, Accept-Language syntax, or Resource.language interactions should proceed through a new final FHIR-I or Vocabulary decision.
issue_request: FHIR-16586 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It asked how $validate and code validation should behave when resources carry display values in a language different from the server's terminology displays; the accepted resolution was to add an implementation note that the current behavior was undefined and might receive later requirements or recommendations.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 40233ff25aafe9f17dcad8777c6dccaf90bccafa, which added the note to the Resource $validate and ValueSet $validate-code spreadsheet sources. The current XML OperationDefinitions retain those notes in source/resource/operationdefinition-Resource-validate.xml and source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml.
additional_context: The same 2018 Zulip thread also led to FHIR-17218 for ValueSet $validate-code invalid-display result status; that issue is already represented on the combined branch. Later applied issues FHIR-39526, FHIR-40770, and FHIR-41229 added Resource $validate language/display controls, repeated displayLanguage semantics, and lenient-display-validation. These later decisions refine parameter behavior without requiring the old Resource.language-based proposal or a new FHIR-16586 source edit.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The combined branch already has the accepted FHIR-16586 caveat in the active Resource and ValueSet operation sources, and adding the old broad caveat to CodeSystem $validate-code would be inappropriate because that operation is covered by later Vocabulary decisions.
